answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks using optical challenge-response tokens as physical unclonable keys. Nodes authenticate by measuring laser speckle scattered through a resin coupon containing powdered marble, raw umber, and crushed onyx. An attacker cannot clone these random patterns digitally, requiring separate physical tokens and optical readers per fake identity. One drawback is that thermal drift alters the speckle profile, occasionally rejecting valid nodes.
